specs.Item Type Name: Mini UPS Basic for WiFi Routers

features: Oakter Mini UPS Basic: Uninterrupted Power for Your WiFi Router!: Stay connected, always! Get up to 3 hours of power backup for your 12V WiFi router and broadband modem with the Oakter Mini UPS Basic.

Smart UPS Technology: Mini UPS Basic (Product RNo.: 84007030, Battery RNo. : 81022748)features an intelligent battery management system that self-charges when electricity is available. With online UPS technology, there's no need for manual switching between power sources.

Seamless Streaming & Long-Lasting Power Backup: Zero lag and interference ensure a comfortable streaming experience. Get up to 3 hours of power backup, depending on your Wi-Fi router's model. Perfect for home offices, online gaming, and streaming.
Plug-N-Play Convenience: Easy installation! Simply replace your WiFi router's power adapter with the Mini UPS, and you're good to go!

Supported WiFi Routers: Mini UPS for WiFi Router supports all type of 12V DC WiFi Routers, Broadband modems, Set-top box and CCTV cameras(12V-0.5A, 12V-1A, 12V-1.5A, 12V-2A,). Supported all major routers like D-Link, TP-Link, Cisco, Mi, Tenda, Nokia, Asus, Linksys, airtel, BSNL, ACT, Netgear, and more except Jio Air fiber (Before buying please ensure your WiFi router is 12V DC). Supports most ISP WiFi routers. Not compatible with AirFiber (PoE) setups that require an antenna (outdoor unit)
Safety First: Protection from overcurrent, short circuit, overcharging, discharging, and high voltage for your peace of mind.
